meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会拥有 UI 细节品味的判断力,专攻界面打磨。它审查界面代码时,会固定用「Before / After / Why」表格给出修改建议,并依据动画决策框架判断该不该加动画、用什么缓动和时长,让界面手感更细腻。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 审查或改进界面代码,或询问动画、组件、交互细节的设计建议时,它会启用这套理念。首次被调用且你没给具体问题时,它先只回复一段知识来源说明,再等你细化。

say.text: 帮我看这段按钮代码,怎么改才更有反馈感?
say.note: 它会按框架分析并给出 Before/After 表格。

say.text: 这个下拉菜单该用多快的动画和什么缓动?
say.note: 它会依据决策框架给时长与曲线建议。

say.text: 用 Emil 的设计理念审查我的弹窗组件代码
say.note: 它会输出修改建议表格。

howto.what_en: This skill gives Claude Emil Kowalski's UI polish philosophy. When reviewing code, it responds with a Before/After/Why markdown table and applies an animation decision framework (should it animate, purpose, easing, duration) before suggesting changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to review or improve UI code, or ask about animation design. On first invocation with no specific question, it only sends a short intro and waits.

say_en.text: Review this button code — how can it feel more responsive?
say_en.note: It analyzes via framework and returns a Before/After table.

say_en.text: What duration and easing should this dropdown use?
say_en.note: It gives speed and curve suggestions per the framework.

say_en.text: Apply Emil's philosophy to review my modal component code.
say_en.note: It returns a table of recommended changes.
